name: DocFX
description: DocFX is a .NET static site generator for documentation that builds Markdown conceptual pages and API reference through Mustache templates.
notes: Benchmarked with a minimal custom template (single conceptual page template, no navbar, TOC, search or affix) instead of the default template. DocFX cannot list pages from a page, so build_command first runs mkindex.sh, which writes index.md from the posts' front matter (part of the timed build).
